create_pixel_decoder: create a PixelDecoder instance with a given feature dimension and number of layers
run_pixel_decoder_forward: run the PixelDecoder forward pass to reconstruct RGB observations from a feature vector
build_decoder_with_factory: build a decoder using the make_decoder factory function with a specified decoder type
log_pixel_decoder_outputs: log the PixelDecoder intermediate outputs and parameters for training visualization
review_pixel_decoder_architecture: review the PixelDecoder class architecture including fully connected and transposed convolution layers
